rows.text: Dear esteemed guest, I detect no more nymphs in the "Sanctum of Prophecy." Impressive work!
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: The nymphs' energy has converged here, and oddly enough, there's also an extra palm of a hand...
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker

rows.text: Please come back and have a look! Please!
rows.speaker: Garmentmaker
